facts.text: The project controls the Hamilton Vantage liquid handler using PyLabRobot on a Raspberry Pi 5
try.py builds a PyLabRobot LiquidHandler over the Vantage backend and a VantageDeck
The clone contains a concrete PyLabRobot Incubator front end
Incubator.setup awaits the backend setup and then registers the racks
Incubator.get_num_free_sites sums the free sites of every rack
Incubator.fetch_plate_to_loading_tray fetches the named plate and moves it to the loading tray
Incubator.take_in_plate moves the loading-tray plate into a chosen site
Incubator.set_temperature delegates to the backend set_temperature
Incubator.get_temperature delegates to the backend get_temperature
Incubator.open_door and close_door delegate to the backend
Incubator.start_shaking takes a frequency and delegates to the backend
Incubator.stop_shaking delegates to the backend stop_shaking
The Cytomat backend's set_temperature raises NotImplementedError
Cytomat.get_temperature returns the incubation query's actual value
Machine.stop calls backend.stop and is the lifecycle teardown, not a motion stop
HamiltonLiquidHandler.stop fails every waiting task and clears the queue; it writes no stop command

safe_state.description: No acknowledged stop: the e-stop sends Incubator.stop_shaking, which stops only the shaker, and then reports SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED; a plate transfer in progress, the door and temperature control are not stopped, since the front end has no stop or heater-off command and Machine.stop is teardown
